mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movies (tmdb_id, title, original_title, overview, poster_path, release_date, vote_average, runtime) VALUES (#{tmdbId}, #{title}, #{originalTitle}, #{overview}, #{posterPath}, #{releaseDate}, #{voteAverage}, #{runtime}) ON CONFLICT (tmdb_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tmdb_id, title, original_title, overview, poster_path, release_date, vote_average, runtime FROM movies ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
